comment: Two alternative perfboard versions side by side, each also shown as underside, wiring diagram and PCB: a passive Big Muff tone stack (left) and the same stack with a one-transistor recovery stage (right). Read the first (left, passive) one. C1, C2, R1, R2 carry no value on the board; a table gives six variants, the first (Triangle) is entered. The right-hand version adds 2.7K, 100K, 470K, 10K, 2x 100nF and Q1 (BC549C, BC550C, 2N5088, 2N5089, MPSA18, etc.).
rows: Triangle; table: 3.9nF for Triangle, 73/75 Ram's Head, Russian; 10nF for Flat Mids, Mids Bump

Triangle; table: 22k for all variants except 73 Ram's Head 33k
